subject: INITIATE statement
notes: Rule: 'A successful INITIATE statement places the report in the active state.' (cite.py --check 14.9.21.4 -> OK §14.9.21.4 4)). CODE: `_active = true; // GR4` only on the success path; the three unsuccessful paths (EC-FLOW-REPORT §14.9.49.4 GR10, EC-REPORT-ACTIVE GR2, EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE GR3) each return before it. PROBE p2.cob: after INITIATE, GENERATE runs without EC-REPORT-INACTIVE; pb326_ec_report_active_inactive (spec-derived DERIVATION) proves the first INITIATE activated (the second raises EC-REPORT-ACTIVE) and pb326_ec_report_file_mode proves an unsuccessful INITIATE does not activate. || editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023
